title: Traveling Voices v6a Story Line-Lead
blurb: Both tracks ~full most of the song. Leads only on story-meaningful or gender-fitting lines (confession/intimacy → female; fate/free/claim/dark bridge → male). Shared forever-hooks stay dual.
